topic: Classification of Dysarthria based on the Levels of Severity. A Systematic Review
topic_definition: Stage 2 canonical eligibility, source-faithful to the original paper's screening criteria. Eligible studies classify dysarthria patients or cases by severity levels and assess intelligibility as a factor corresponding to those severity levels.
summary: Stage 2 canonical criteria restated from criteria_mds/2310.07264.md; publication-time fallback filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2310.07264.json.

summary_topics.description: Classification of Dysarthria based on the Levels of Severity. A Systematic Review

required.criterion: The paper's primary goal or task is classifying dysarthria patients or cases based on severity levels.
The paper assesses intelligibility as a factor corresponding to severity levels.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Papers that do not contain the main keywords in title and abstract are excluded.
General chapters related to motor speech disorders are excluded when they are not specifically about dysarthria severity classification.
Studies focused on other disorders such as dysphagia or dementia are excluded.
Tools or software for rehabilitation or therapy are excluded when they are not severity-classification research.
Automatic recognition, detection, or identification of dysarthria is excluded when it does not classify severity levels.
Studies about the impact of specific features of dysarthric cases are excluded when they are not severity-level classification studies.
Binary classification of dysarthria is excluded when it is not severity-level classification.
